description: This file defines the 'Multiplexer' class which implements the 'ReporterV2' interface, managing multiple reporters for test reporting in Playwright. It includes methods for handling test lifecycle events, output streams, and error handling, as well as utility functions for error wrapping.

classes.name: Multiplexer
classes.description: A reporter that multiplexes test events to multiple underlying reporters.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Handles configuration setup for all reporters.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test suite.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Finalizes reporting after all tests, updates overall result status.

methods.name: onExit
methods.description: Called when the test process exits.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test step.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of a test step.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Determines if any reporter outputs to stdio.
